title: GTA 6 has a smell reaction system, which immediately joins Red Dead Redemption 2's dynamically shrinking horse balls on Rockstar's list of immersive symbols of excess
description: Any reminder of Red Dead Redemption 2 's temperature sensitive horse testicles brings a smile to my face. In truth, I can't say I've ever zoomed in close enough to properly take in the spectacle of Arthur Morgan's mount having its nuts dynamically expand and contract based on whether he's riding through snowy mountains or across baking plains, but I do always get a kick out of knowing such a thing's happening as I play. To this point, the horse balls have been the most infamous or meme-worthy example of Rockstar's obsession with going all-in on realistic detail to an arguably unnecessary degree, one that borders on overindulgence which players could conceivably never notice if they weren't expressly told about it. That philosophy's gone nowhere, so GTA 6 was always going to have a feature that'd become as much of a metaphor for excess as those beloved balls. It may well be the smell reaction system revealed in Edge 's long read on the game. Read more

title: Where To Find The Pangzhen Backstreet Courtyard Key In Phantom Blade Zero
description: Are you frustrated since you can’t find the Pangzhen Backstreet Courtyard Key in Phantom Blade Zero? You’ve scoured the entire city. You’ve visited other regions. And yet nothing in the game tells you the locations of that darned item. Well, we’ve got the answer right here, though it seems to be tied to another objective. In This Article The Agonized Ironmask and the Female Puppet Bai Xue quest Bai Xue rewards - Memory Flowers and the Snow & Blood accessory The Agonized Ironmask and the Female Puppet The Pangzhen Backstreet Courtyard Key--believe it or not--can be found in the Mountain of Imprisonment. Specifically, it’s in an area that you pass by on the way to the Shrine Outer Gate. It’s also where you encounter two NPCs, the Agonized Ironmask and the Female Puppet. During our playthrough, we repeatedly talked to both NPCs but nothing happened. We kept trying even after completing the main quest in the region. However, after we completed Hero’s Lament/Moji’s Relic, the Agonized Ironmask suddenly had new dialogue. This led to a short side quest called Ledger of Atonement, where we handed over a book from the caves to the NPC. We then defeated the Ironmask in combat. He dropped a Sha-Chi Amber Fragment and the all-important Pangzhen Backstreet Courtyard Key! These quests involve the Agonized Ironmask and Female Puppet. Bai Xue quest The death of the Agonized Ironmask unlocks a new quest from his Female Puppet companion, Bai Xue. She tasks you with bringing the Bloodstained Necklace to her real body. Now that you have the Pangzhen Backstreet Courtyard Key in Phantom Blade Zero, you’ll be able to do just that. Return to the Pangzhen Green Serpent House and cross the bridge to the locked gate--i.e. the one near Old Man Gen’s house. Open the gate and climb up the walls to reach the rooftop. You should be able to enter Bai Xue’s home. The phantom Bai Xue (left) wants you to bring an item to her real body (right). Bai Xue rewards - Memory Flowers and the Snow & Blood…

title: How To Complete Deep In The Valley In Phantom Blade Zero
description: Do you want to complete Deep in the Valley in Phantom Blade Zero? This optional quest takes place in the game’s first region. It’s imperative that you tackle it when you’re able to, as it opens up a huge section of the zone. In This Article How to start the Deep in the Valley quest Where to find the Sha-Chi Tower Base Camp Gate Key What can you expect once you’re Deep in the Valley? How to start the Deep in the Valley quest The Phantom Blade Zero Deep in the Valley quest is pretty hard to miss. After leaving the Outpost and heading north, you’re bound to run into an NPC who’s standing guard in front of a gate. The poor fella seems to have lost the key, and it’s up to you to find it. Help this fella out. Where to find the Sha-Chi Tower Base Camp Gate Key The Sha-Chi Tower Base Camp Gate Key is in, you guessed it, the actual tower. Well, to be clear, it’s at the very top of the spire, fairly close to where you encounter the Friendly Shadow Warden. Here’s the kicker: You won’t be able to reach it until you have a certain Phantom Edge weapon. For now, just continue the campaign until you’re able to beat The Hunt, the boss that’s been goading you throughout the chapter. He drops the Hunter’s Chain Sickle, which acts akin to a grappling hook. Once you’ve taken out your foe, don’t proceed to the next chapter/region. Instead, go back to the top of the Sha-Chi Tower. You should see a button prompt that allows you to grapple and reach the topmost ledge. Grab the key after you finish off the chapter's main boss. What can you expect once you’re Deep in the Valley? Once you have the key, it’s time to go back to the gate from earlier. The NPC’s nowhere to be found, but you can head through the pass. Aside from the usual rewards, such as upgrade materials, here are some other goodies for you to check out: There’s a Lóng Pillar --i.e. dragon pillar--that leads to a tough boss fight. You can find herbs needed for Yu’er’s Apprentice Healer quest. You’ll be able to explore the…

title: How To Pass Through The Mirrorwood Maze In Phantom Blade Zero
description: Are you stumped by the Mirrorwood maze in Phantom Blade Zero? This area is at the northeastern edge of the Crimson Forest. Aside from clues that tell you what you need to do, you also have to contend with some rather eerie happenings. We’ve got the solution for you, but be ready for some spoilers as well. In This Article What’s in the Mirrorwood? Mirrorwood maze/puzzle solution What happens after you get past the maze? What’s in the Mirrorwood? The Mirrorwood is the last area in the Crimson Forest, assuming you’re tackling main quest objectives. While you’re there, be sure to gather the Memory Flowers of Inanis and Bai Chilian. As for the Phantom Blade Zero Mirrorwood maze or puzzle, it takes place in a small area surrounded by a copse of trees: There are three mirror portals at the left, middle, and right-hand sides. Likewise, there are several Puppet Children frolicking around, though they won’t attack you. However, you need to watch out for annoying Crows that love to peck and scratch Soul. Step into a strange area after tagging the bell near one of Inanis' Memory Flowers. Mirrorwood maze/puzzle solution What makes the Mirrorwood maze somewhat confusing is that it’s based on audio cues. If you check the trees, you’ll see this engraved message: “Follow the sound of weeping.” With this in mind, turn up the volume of your TV and walk closer to each mirror portal. Listen closely and, if you hear a woman crying or sobbing, it means it’s the correct one. Go through that portal to reach another area, whereupon you have to listen for the weeping sound once more. In any case, here’s the solution: First sequence: Left -> Middle -> Right. Second sequence: Right -> Left -> Middle. Pass through portals where someone is weeping (left) until you're able to reach the exit (right). What happens after you get past the maze? If you did it right for each sequence, the mists should part. Then, after the second sequence, the way forward should be clear. You’ll see another bell that…

title: How To Complete Yu’er Healer Quests In Phantom Blade Zero
description: Are you hoping to complete Yu’er’s quests in Phantom Blade Zero? This rather innocent-looking herbalist just wants to find aid for her father. Likewise, she wants to do some good in this world, and it’s up to Soul to be her protector. In This Article Yu’er’s quests and requirements Apprentice Healer and Flesh Lily quests Flesh Lily location and the Hua boss fight Apprentice Healer herbs and reward Healer’s Mercy quest What happens afterward? Yu’er’s quests and requirements You meet Yu’er in Phantom Blade Zero very early in the campaign as you’re traversing the riverside in Weeping Creek Valley. Eventually upon arriving at the Outpost and defeating Peng Meng the Axemaster, you’ll see that Yu’er has moved right next to Forge, the NPC that teaches the weapon upgrade system. Yu'er shows up in the Outpost. Apprentice Healer and Flesh Lily quests Yu’er has a couple of quests for you in Weeping Creek Valley. Looks like you’ll be searching for herbs and flowers. Flesh Lily location and the Hua boss fight The Flesh Lily requires you to face a tough opponent named Hua, the Betrothed. While you’re on the ground floor of the Sha-Chi Tower, look for an opening that has a sloping bridge that causes Soul to slide down. It leads you to a pond and, beyond that, there’s a gravesite where you battle a boss. Hua drops the Scarlet Wraithblade, a two-handed weapon that makes sha-chi draining plants to bloom. Don’t forget to pick up the glowing quest item--the Flesh Lily--in the area, too. Apprentice Healer herbs and reward For Apprentice Healer, you have to find three herbs in the region: Blood-Stopper Vine - By the river east of the Axemaster’s Holding Cell. Congealeaf - You need to complete Deep in the Valley to gain entry to a large optional area at the base of the Sha-Chi Tower. You should see an orange item in the settlement further west of the swordsmen encampment. Blemish Goldweed - This one is near the Lóng Pillar in this region. For your efforts, you’ll receive the Medicine…

title: How To Unlock Skills In Phantom Blade Zero
description: Are you curious about how to unlock skills in Phantom Blade Zero? Various perks can be found in the “Train Abilities” menu, which is accessible whenever you interact with a bell/fast travel point. However, there are some caveats related to progression and exploration. In This Article The Phantom Blade Zero skill unlock system Interconnected perks and Banyan’s Hearts The Phantom Blade Zero skill unlock system Unlocking skills in the game isn’t as straightforward as it seems. You still spend the default resource--i.e. Remnant Dust--though additional perks are locked behind the collectibles/upgrades you’ve acquired. Here’s what you need to know: Abilities come in three categories/rows, which have to be unlocked in sequential order (left to right). These categories/rows are tied to collectibles--i.e. Blackstone (attack upgrades), Sha-Chi Amber (energy upgrades), and Memory Flowers (health upgrades). Let’s say a skill can only be unlocked once you have 4x Blackstone. This means you need to obtain a total of 16x Blackstone Fragments through exploration. Naturally, certain perks only become available near the tail-end of the campaign once you’ve searched almost every nook and cranny. Our Phantom Blade Zero skill tree before we concluded the campaign. Interconnected perks and Banyan’s Hearts You might’ve noticed the second and fourth rows, which are between the three main categories. These are interconnected perks that can be activated (a) once the connected nodes have been unlocked and (b) if you have enough Banyan’s Hearts. Banyan’s Hearts come from Banyan Tree encounters where you face waves of enemies, including duo boss fights. You may also purchase a few of them from Quick Hand Zhang, as each one costs 100,000 Remnant Dust. You can learn more about these battles in our Banyan Tree locations guide. There are eight Banyan's Hearts in the game, one for every interconnected perk/node. That does it for our article about how to unlock Phantom Blade Zero skills and…

title: How To Upgrade Your Gear In Phantom Blade Zero
description: Want to upgrade your gear in Phantom Blade Zero? Every type of equipment in the game--from main weapons and secondary weapons, to accessories and medicine--can be boosted further. You just need to meet certain NPCs and acquire the right materials. In This Article Upgrades in Phantom Blade Zero: Important NPCs and where to find them Weapon upgrades: How they work and what materials do you need Accessories and medicine upgrades: How they work and what materials do you need Weapons and Soul Temper Upgrades in Phantom Blade Zero: Important NPCs and where to find them There are four NPCs related to Phantom Blade Zero’s weapon and gear upgrade system. After chatting with them for the first time, their function is automatically unlocked in every bell/fast travel point. You just need to click on the Upgrade Equipment menu. You don’t even have to revisit the NPCs. Main weapon and Phantom Edge upgrades: Forge - This lady is in the Outpost in Weeping Creek Valley, the game’s first region. Accessories: Jewel - She has a shop at the cliffside area in the Village of Lu. Soul Temper: Myst - She owns a tavern in the city of Pangzhen. You visit this location as part of the main quest. Medicines: Xie Xaorong - He operates the Green Serpent House, which is in the western portion of Pangzhen. Talk to characters like Jewel (left) and Xie Xaorong (right) to permanently unlock their functions. Weapon upgrades: How they work and what materials do you need Weapon upgrades in Phantom Blade Zero require resources like metals and solvents. The type differs depending on the weapon classification--i.e. Forged Metal for one-handers, Broadplate Metals for two-handers, and Twinned Metals for dual-wielded armaments. Phantom Edges also have their own materials depending on their classification--i.e. Destructive, Ranged, Martial, and Artifice, and Summoning. Both main and secondary weapons gain additional perks at levels 5, 10, 15, and 25. You can also press a button to upgrade something to its max…

title: How To Complete Old Man Gen’s Quests In Phantom Blade Zero
description: Do you want to complete Old Man Gen’s quest in Phantom Blade Zero? This carriage driver braved the dangers of the road, bringing you to your destination at the start of the campaign. Now, he has a few tasks that you ought to finish. We discuss all the steps, but be ready for some minor spoilers, too. In This Article Old Man Gen’s location and missions How to complete Leave None Alive How to complete The Journey Home Old Man Gen in Meigu Lake Old Man Gen’s location and missions Your introduction to Old Man Gen happens during the initial stages of the game, when Soul unceremoniously tosses him off the carriage to keep him safe. The next time you meet the friendly fella is in the Village of Lu. You’ll see him on a second-floor landing, while trying to avoid zombie-like Maskwalkers down below. Clear out the enemies in the area and chat with Old Man Gen to receive a couple of quests: Leave None Alive and The Journey Home. Save the hapless fella and don't throw him around again. How to complete Leave None Alive To complete this Old Man Gen quest in Phantom Blade Zero, you must return to the Outpost at Weeping Creek Valley and the Thieves’ Camp in Crimson Forest. In Weeping Creek Valley, you’ll see that everyone has turned hostile, except for Forge--i.e. the blacksmith/weapon upgrades NPC. Defeat the Bronze Man monk in the Outpost to receive a quest item. You can go across the bridge that was previously barricaded and guarded by troops. In the Crimson Forest, it seems that all the NPCs have died, though hostiles still abound. Take them out to receive another quest item. You can bring these items over to two NPCs in the Village of Lu: The Wounded Thief NPC near the Smuggler’s Tunnel Entrance rewards you with the Arrowward, an accessory that improves your defense against ranged damage. The Stately Monk in the Survivors’ Courtyard gives you the Agarwood Prayer Beads, which increase sha-chi recovery if your guard is broken. The Wounded Thief (left) and Stately Monk (right)…

title: Where To Find Moji’s Relic In Phantom Blade Zero – Hero’s Lament Guide
description: Are you scratching your head while trying to find Moji’s Relic in Phantom Blade Zero? This item is required for a quest called Hero’s Lament and the clues are rather vague. Still, if you can complete this task, you’ll have new objectives to tackle. In This Article Hero’s Lament quest: Liu Yi and Master Moji The Detached Cage Lever Moji’s Bloodstained Sword Phantom Edge: Ink Cut Hero’s Lament quest: Liu Yi and Master Moji To start the Phantom Blade Zero Hero’s Lament quest, you need to trek all the way to the Mountain of Imprisonment. Keep following the main objective until you exit a large cavern and meet an NPC named Liu Yi. He’ll tell you about the damaged lift, as well as his former master, Moji. He wants you to retrieve Moji’s relic somewhere in the summit. Liu Yi feels despondent due to the loss of his master. The Detached Cage Lever The goal now is to find the Detached Cage Lever. It’s located near the Commander’s Platform bell--i.e. where you fought a boss named Bi Feng, Giant Saber Commander. Climb up the archer tower and look at the nearby collapsed house. You should spot a glowing item, so drop down to collect it. Note: If the item isn’t there, then perhaps you need to complete the main objective by defeating the chapter boss in the northwestern part of the map. Moji’s Bloodstained Sword In any case, you can use the lever that you just found in the area with the hanging cells. If you’ve already explored this region before, then it's the place where Lu Sanqian got imprisoned for the second time. Go to the upper section and lower the cell via the mechanism. Then, check it out to obtain Moji’s Bloodstained Sword. This is Moji’s Relic in Phantom Blade Zero. The locations of the Detached Cage Lever (left) and Moji's Bloodstained Sword (right). Phantom Edge: Ink Cut Return to Liu Yi and bring him the sword. He’ll surprisingly commit suicide, believing that his blood will help purify the weapon. This nets you the Ink Cut, a new Phantom Edge. The Ink Cut is a…

title: How To Repair The Illusory Pipa In Phantom Blade Zero
description: Are you eager to repair the Illusory Pipa in Phantom Blade Zero? This musical instrument is obtained a few hours into the campaign, but it’s going to take a long time before you can fully utilize its functions as a Phantom Edge weapon. We’ve got all the info for you right here, though there are some minor spoilers, too. In This Article The Illusory Pipa location and quest NPC Where to find the Illusory Pipa Head Where to find the Illusory Pipa Backplate Where to find the Illusory Pipa Strings Illusory Pipa functions in combat and exploration The Illusory Pipa location and quest NPC The Phantom Blade Zero Illusory Pipa is acquired once Soul wakes up in the Village of Lu, the game’s third region. The broken item will be in your inventory and the only person who can repair it is in Pangzhen, the next zone in the campaign. Assuming you’re able to reach Pangzhen, progress through the main quest until you arrive at Myst’s Tavern. The proprietor, Myst, says that she can restore the instrument for you. However, you need to collect three components, namely the Illusory Pipa Head, Illusory Pipa Backplate, and Illusory Pipa Strings. Myst in Pangzhen will be able to restore the Illusory Pipa. Where to find the Illusory Pipa Head The Illusory Pipa Head is dropped by a secret boss in the Village of Lu. This opponent, Dusk the Puppeteer, is in the dark pit in the eastern part of the settlement. You have to gather all the Firefly Memory Flowers to gain access to the area. Dusk summons puppet minions, including shielded ones and creepy aunties that are out for blood. He also creates a clone once he’s low on health, making the battle more hectic. If you manage to beat him, he’ll drop the quest item, as well as the Puppeteer’s Bell. It’s a Phantom Edge that lets you summon a Sword-and-Shield and a Spear-and-Shield Puppet. Where to find the Illusory Pipa Backplate The next component for the Phantom Blade Zero Illusory Pipa is the Backplate, which comes from the Mandate Encampment.…

title: How To Enter The Crimson Manor In Phantom Blade Zero
description: Looking to enter the Crimson Manor in Phantom Blade Zero? While this ominous-looking home can be seen early in the campaign, it’s going to take a lot of hours before you can actually gain access. We’ve got all the details for you in our guide, but be forewarned of a few spoilers as well. In This Article Crimson Manor location - The Weeping Creek Valley and the Mute door The Herald’s Illusion and the Puppet’s Tongue The first portal The second portal The third portal What’s inside and below the Crimson Manor? Crimson Manor location - The Weeping Creek Valley and the Mute door The Phantom Blade Zero Crimson Manor is actually in the first major region: Weeping Creek Valley. Here’s what you need to know: You must complete a side quest called Deep in the Valley. It lets you explore a chunk of the zone, including the lower section of the Sha-Chi Tower. At the bottom of the Sha-Chi Tower, you’ll notice a Powderkeg enemy that keeps spawning. Stand near the wooden ruins and rubble and lure it toward you. Then, step away before it explodes. The explosion should reveal a lift that takes you down to the depths. Early on, there’s not much you can do. If you approach the puppet-door--later known as Mute--a notification will simply state that it’s missing its tongue. A side quest even tells you to just “keep exploring.” Still, you can pick up the Ancient Armor Fragment near a gnarled tree. It’s an accessory that improves damage reduction. The Powderkeg enemy (left) helps reveal a way to reach the Crimson Manor, though you can't open the door just yet (right). The Herald’s Illusion and the Puppet’s Tongue Your goal now is to find the Puppet’s Tongue to open the door. But there’s a catch: You must visit three different portals that lead to the Three-Eyed Puppet. This leads to a quest called The Herald’s Illusion. The first portal The first portal is in the Village of Lu, specifically in the Puppet Testing Grounds. You reach this area by completing the main quest objectives and…

title: How To Reach The Mountain Of Imprisonment In Phantom Blade Zero
description: Are you planning to trek to the Mountain of Imprisonment in Phantom Blade Zero? This is another zone you should visit before you finish the campaign. Reaching the summit shouldn’t be a tall order if you already meet the requirements. In This Article Mountain of Imprisonment location and parting mists Notable quests and NPCs in the Mountain of Imprisonment The last piece of the puzzle, er, puppet Mountain of Imprisonment location and parting mists The Phantom Blade Zero Mountain of Imprisonment can be accessed via Meigu Lake, the large body of water that separates settlements like Pangzhen and the Village of Lu. The entrance is near an island dock in the northeastern part of the lake. That said, it’s impassable by default since it’s shrouded in mist. However, once you repair the Illusory Pipa, you can play it at that location to make the fog disappear. This leads to a cutscene where Soul wakes up in a new region. You can clear the mists once you have the Illusory Pipa. Notable quests and NPCs in the Mountain of Imprisonment What makes the Mountain of Imprisonment worth a visit is that certain quests that come from other regions can only be tackled here. If there’s a quest that made you scratch your head because you couldn’t track it initially or you couldn’t figure out the next step, then there’s a chance that the objective might be here. For instance, there’s the Cui quest from the Village of Lu. You’ll find Cui’s grandfather trapped in a cage in this region. Speaking of caged characters, there’s also the Ailing Man, who’s part of the Don’t Forget Me quest from an NPC in Pangzhen. Help out NPCs like Zhou Ping (left) and Lu Sanqian (right). A certain mission also leads to even more quests. The Hero’s Lament/Moji’s Relic objective grants a powerful Phantom Blade. In turn, you’ll be able to talk to another NPC who provides their own quest, which then leads to a different task from their companion. Funnily enough, this arc is how you can finally acquire that darned…

title: How To Reach The Mandate Encampment In Phantom Blade Zero
description: Do you want to go to the Mandate Encampment in Phantom Blade Zero? The highlands to the east hide numerous secrets, but you'll need to put in a bit of effort to reach it. In This Article Mandate Encampment location and key Mandate Encampment environment Notable rewards and activities in the Mandate Encampment Mandate Encampment location and key You can access the Phantom Blade Zero Mandate Encampment zone via the Village of Lu. It’s actually in the eastern part of the region near the starting area. However, you’ll soon realize that the gate is locked. To open it, you have to progress further into the campaign until you reach the city of Pangzhen. Eventually, you’ll face a boss named Gu Wanyue, the Wailing Wraith. After defeating her, jump down the well and follow the path. You should see the Mandate Encampment Gate Key right next to a Memory Flower. Eliminate Gu Wanyue (left) so you can retrieve the key to the Mandate Encampment (right). Mandate Encampment environment Your trek through the Mandate Encampment takes you to the Cliffside Walkway, which leads to a sprawling battlefield. Watch out because hostiles will swarm you once you get too close. You can take two divergent paths to reach your objective in the Training Grounds. Plenty of battles await you in the Mandate Encampment. Notable rewards and activities in the Mandate Encampment The Phantom Blade Zero Mandate Encampment zone has a boss that drops the Bashpole. This Phantom Edge weapon can be used for exploration, smashing through floorboards to reveal hidden treasure chests. Speaking of Phantom Edges, you can boost the damage of Destruction-type armaments by collecting fragments of the Guardian Idol accessory. Oh, and as far as bosses are concerned, one potential foe drops the Soft Snake Sword, which is great for parrying blows effectively. Another starts a side quest where you collect the discarded relics of heroes, leading to a Soul Temper material as a reward. Finally, the aforementioned Training…

title: How To Reach Meigu Lake In Phantom Blade Zero
description: Do you want to sail across Meigu Lake in Phantom Blade Zero? This large body of water is bordered by various settlements, including the Village of Lu and the city of Pangzhen. You need a certain item to travel to this location, though, and that's probably what's tripping you up. Here's what you need to know. In This Article Meigu Lake location and the Flaming Mane Meigu Lake Sha-Chi Tower, islands, and the Illusory Pipa The Frozen Lake Dock and Four Guardians’ Mirror Meigu Lake location and the Flaming Mane The Phantom Blade Zero Meigu Lake zone can be accessed via the northeastern corner of Pangzhen near the Pavilion of Knowledge. Unfortunately, the path that leads you there is blocked by thorny brambles. Your goal, therefore, is to find a Phantom Edge called the Flaming Mane. You must complete the main objectives in Pangzhen until you defeat the Lion Dance Grandmaster all the way in the northwestern corner of the city. Then, upon visiting another NPC that’s marked on your map, you should be able to activate the Flaming Mane to burn vines thoroughly. From the aforementioned northeastern path, follow the streets and traverse the rooftops until you encounter a boss named Soulclaimer. Once you’ve beaten him, you should have full access to the docks and cliffside area. Torch the brambles (left) and beat Soulclaimer (right). Meigu Lake Sha-Chi Tower, islands, and the Illusory Pipa You can explore the ground and upper levels of the Sha-Chi Tower, but what you really need to do is enter it via the lower section. This can be done by sailing the mechanized boat off to the northern side of the structure and looking for an opening. In fact, you’ll mostly sail across the lake to dock on islands and tag bells, slowly revealing the entirety of the map. Notable locations include the Songhouse Island, which has a large pavilion that’s in ruins. It’s where you can fight a boss that drops a necessary component for the Illusory Pipa. title: Cyberpunk trading sim Probably Stolen is about running a kiosk in a space station full of gangs, megacorps, and secret rogue cyborgs
description: I have so far not been shivved, shanked, brain fried, hazed, wasted, ironed, short-circed, flat-lined or even complained at in Probably Stolen - Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim, but I'm sure it's just a matter of time. In this neuromantic kiosk game from Questing Goose Studio, you're a new store owner aboard a backwater space station. Each day, you roll up the shutter and do business with a procession of shady types, ranging from janitors with unappetising beards to sexy cowled folk with Main Character tattoos. The basics are simple enough, for all the overwhelmingly menu-led presentation: buy what you can afford, according to your instinct for the wider market, sell what you can fit into the customer's budget. But things quickly get complicated. Read more
